items.title: NIST SP 800-53 Control Families Overview
items.summary: Introduces SP 800-53 control families, baselines and tailoring concepts.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Introduces SP 800-53 control families, baselines and tailoring concepts. This lesson focuses on practical understanding, decision-making and evidence-based GRC practice.

sections.heading: Key concepts
sections.body: Core concepts for nist sp 800-53 control families overview are explained in plain language, with emphasis on roles, controls, risks and expected outcomes in an enterprise context.

sections.heading: Application
sections.body: Learners should be able to apply the concepts to realistic scenarios, justify decisions, and recognise common gaps or weaknesses.

examples.title: Applying NIST SP 800-53 Control Families Overview
examples.context: A team must address nist sp 800-53 control families overview in a business scenario with limited time and resources.
examples.outcome: A risk-informed, documented decision with clear ownership and follow-up actions.

practicalExercise.title: Exercise: NIST SP 800-53 Control Families Overview
practicalExercise.brief: Apply the lesson to a fictional organisation facing challenges related to nist sp 800-53 control families overview.
practicalExercise.deliverable: A short action plan with rationale.
